# origincloud_compute_instances (Data Source)

Lists the instances in a zone, oldest first. A terminated instance is listed for two hours after it was terminated. For every zone's instances, list the zones whose `services` name `compute` with the `origincloud_location_zones` data source, then each zone's instances.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose instances to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose instances to list.

### Read-Only

- `instances` (Attributes List) The instances listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances))

<a id="nestedatt--instances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances`

Read-Only:

- `boot_volume` (Attributes) The boot volume: its size and storage class at launch, and the volume. The image's size on the default storage class when left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances--boot_volume))
- `create_time` (String) When the instance was launched. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that launched the instance, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`.
- `health` (Attributes) Whether the platform can currently confirm the instance is working, which `state` doesn't say: a `RUNNING` instance on a machine that stopped answering is still `RUNNING`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances--health))
- `image` (String) The image the boot volume is created from, in the instance's zone: one of the project's own, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/images/{image}`, or a public one, `zones/{zone}/images/{image}`. Set exactly one of `image` and `image_family`; launched from a family, this is the public image the family resolved to.
- `image_family` (String) The image family to launch the current public image of, `imageFamilies/{image_family}`. Set exactly one of `image` and `image_family`. Empty when the instance was launched from an image.
- `instance_type` (String) The instance type, `instanceTypes/{instance_type}`, such as `instanceTypes/gp1.core.2`: one whose `available` is true. Changing it needs the instance `STOPPED`.
- `interface_addresses` (Attributes List) Each network interface's private addresses, in the order of `network_interfaces`; an interface not attached yet has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances--interface_addresses))
- `key_pair` (String) The key pair whose public key is installed for `login_user`, in the instance's project.
- `login_user` (String) The account to log in as: a user created at first boot that holds the key pair. A POSIX user name of at most 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or an underscore, and not `root`. The image's `default_user` when left empty.
- `name` (String) The instance's resource name.
- `network_interfaces` (List of String) The network interfaces, in device order, the boot interface first; exactly one today. Each is an existing interface in the instance's project and zone that nothing else holds, created with the network service: its subnet and security groups are the instance's. Terminating the instance releases it, and it stays. An instance launched before interfaces were named at launch shows the interface created for it, which is deleted with the instance.
- `state` (String) Where the instance is in its lifecycle. One of `INITIALIZING`, `PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `STOPPING`, `STOPPED`, `SHUTTING_DOWN`, `TERMINATED`, `FAILED`.
- `state_reason` (String) Why the instance is `FAILED`, or why a `STOPPED` instance went down when the machine it ran on failed; empty otherwise.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.
- `urn` (String) The instance's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.

<a id="nestedatt--instances--boot_volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances.boot_volume`

Read-Only:

- `size_gib` (Number) The size in GiB the volume was created with, at least the image's size; the image's size when left at 0. Grow the volume itself to resize it; this keeps the size at launch.
- `storage_class` (String) The storage class, `storageClasses/{storage_class}` of the persistent volume service; the default class when left empty.
- `volume` (String) The volume, in the instance's project and zone.


<a id="nestedatt--instances--health"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances.health`

Read-Only:

- `availability` (String) The summary of `checks`, for a listing that shows one value per instance. Only the checks say whether a problem is the platform's or the instance's own. One of `AVAILABLE`, `IMPAIRED`, `UNKNOWN`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`.
- `checks` (Attributes List) Every check, always all of them: one with nothing to report is `NOT_APPLICABLE` or `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, never left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances--health--checks))

<a id="nestedatt--instances--health--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances.health.checks`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Whose the subject is, derived from `kind`. One of `SYSTEM`, `INSTANCE`.
- `change_time` (String) When the check came to `outcome`; empty while nothing has observed it. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `kind` (String) What the check observes. One of `HOST_REACHABLE`, `DOMAIN_STATE`, `NETWORK_REACHABLE`, `GUEST_AGENT`, `GUEST_PRESENT`.
- `outcome` (String) Its outcome. One of `OK`, `IMPAIRED`, `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`.



<a id="nestedatt--instances--interface_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances.interface_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `ipv4_address` (String) Its private IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Its IPv6 address.
- `network_interface` (String) The network interface.
